elements.title: Folders of data
elements.fulfilled_by: computed from inputs/: at least one file

elements.title: Systems identified
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › systems[] (id, label, icon, cite, role), with nodes[].systems

elements.title: Modules and capabilities
elements.fulfilled_by: inventory/<name>.json › modules[] (id, title, software, steps, cite): observed mode needs grounded evidence; suggested/default mode also needs likelihood and inferred evidence

elements.title: Folder view
elements.fulfilled_by: computed from inputs/ and records/: one row per file

elements.title: Citation points section
elements.fulfilled_by: computed from the cites of process-map/<name>.json › systems[].cite and .software.cite, and inventory/<name>.json › modules[].cite: every cited row carries a numbered marker, and section#citation-points lists exactly the points the page uses
